:::{#thm-mle-use-log}
#### Maximize the log-likelihood instead of the likelihood

If $\Lik(\param) > 0$ for every $\param$,
the likelihood and log-likelihood have the same maximizers:

$$
\am_\param \Lik(\param) = \am_\param \lik(\param)
$$
:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-mle-use-log.

:::
